pages.text: $(bold)Iron Coffin Mountain$(): the iron coffin topples; the very mountain burns.$(br2)$(bold)Expansion$(): press the domain expansion key to unfold the domain around yourself - it seals its occupants in like any other domain, draining radius x50 curse power per second. Every target inside except the caster is $(red)kept perpetually on fire$(), and $(red)takes a curse-scorch hit every 5 ticks that ignores invulnerability frames$() - the damage scales with curse output/affinity (0.6 + output x0.35 + affinity x0.01 per hit), while armor, resistance and similar defenses still reduce it.

$(bold)Technique resistance$(): as with Taizang Field, this domain's fire and scorch $(bold)can be resisted by the three New Shadow Style techniques$() (Mikoshi Kago / Falling Blossom / Simple Domain make you immune while you have enough curse power) - only Execution cannot be resisted.$(br2)$(bold)Notes$(): creatures sealed within the domain's walls cannot escape the sea of fire; entities immune to fire (Nether mobs, Fire Resistance potion) are not re-ignited, but the curse scorch still applies in full.
